😎 Speaker at Digital Bridge 2025 — Pegor Papazyan

Pegor Papazyan is the Director of Development at TUMO Center for Creative Technologies, where he leads strategic initiatives in international expansion, system automation, and the development of educational products and platforms.

🎓 He played a key role in creating TUMO’s learning management system and brings extensive experience across the public, private, and non-profit sectors.

💼 His previous roles include:
— Program Development Lead at the U.S. Agency for International Development (USAID)
— CEO of the National Competitiveness Foundation of Armenia
— Founder of the virtual agents platform Bazillion Beings

📚 Education
— Bachelor of Architecture, American University of Beirut
— MBA, Booth School of Business, University of Chicago
— Master’s in Computer Science, Massachusetts Institute of Technology (MIT), where he was a member of the AI Lab

✨ At Digital Bridge 2025, Pegor will share his insights on the future of education and technology.

👉 Learn more and register at digitalbridge.kz
